title: Saga 2.3 verify drops two plan-mandated end-state gates (minterV2 seeded; phUSD minter authority V1-off/V2-on) to log-only / unchecked
description: 2.3 is the saga's declared FINAL verification step, and its plan (Section 5 Script 3 step 4 / Section 5.4) enumerates the end-state gates to 'assert all'. The implemented _verify is an incomplete superset of that plan: it never re-checks `phUSD.minters(V1)==false` / `phUSD.minters(V2)==true` nor the USDe-client wiring, and it demotes the minterV2 principals to console.log rather than asserting them. The saga's declared final gate therefore passes green without catching a divergence in the phUSD minter authority regime (V1-off / V2-on) or the USDe client wiring.
impact: None at direct risk. If minter authority were mis-set (V1 still a minter, or V2 not), phUSD mint accounting could diverge from the intended V2-only regime, but that mis-set requires a 2.1 failure or a separate owner action and is independently surfaced by 2.1's own asserts. 2.3 itself writes nothing wrong here; it merely fails to re-assert. This is a Law-2 spec/story deviation: the step whose stated job is to 'assert all' final gates implements an incomplete superset of its own plan (Section 5.4) — surfaced at honest severity in the dedicated spec-conformance channel (F-S23-02), not buried in the QA/gas bundle.
attackPath: 1. 2.1 lands strategies/JSON but fails at the phUSD setMinter step (2.1 step 8), OR an owner later re-flips minter authority.
2. Operator runs 2.3 expecting plan Section 5.4 'assert all' coverage.
3. 2.3 _verify never re-checks `phUSD.minters(V1)==false` / `(V2)==true` nor the USDe-client wiring, and demotes minterV2 principals to console.log.
4. The saga's declared final gate passes green without catching the divergence — the operator believes a green 2.3 == plan 5.4 fully satisfied.
recommendation: Promote the plan-mandated gates from log-only / unchecked to hard assertions in 2.3 _verify: assert `phUSD.minters(V1)==false` and `phUSD.minters(V2)==true`, assert the USDe-client wiring, so the declared final verification step actually satisfies its own plan Section 5.4. (The minterV2-principal log-only relaxation is a documented, defensible relaxation and not itself a defect; the unchecked phUSD/USDe gates are the reportable drift.)
evidence: Fork-verified (script-auditor, run-18): 2.3 itself executes cleanly and writes nothing wrong; _verify (L103-114) demotes minterV2 principals to console.log and omits the phUSD V1-off/V2-on and USDe-client wiring assertions that the plan (Section 5 Script 3 step 4 / 5.4) enumerates as gates to 'assert all'.
